query: short_name=GEDI_L4B_Gridded_Biomass_V2_1_2299; layers MU, SE; region=uk; bbox W,S,E,N=-8.7,49.8,1.9,60.9
processing: Global 1 km GeoTIFFs (EASE-Grid 2.0, EPSG:6933) clipped by scripts/clip_to_bbox.py raster (native grid window of the box's projected bounds, deflate); global originals deleted. Units Mg/ha; nodata -9999.

granules.meaning: standard error of mean AGBD, Mg/ha

notes: GEDI samples only ~51.6 S to 51.6 N (ISS orbit) over Apr 2019 - Mar 2023. Cells north of ~51.6 N (most of the UK box) and unsampled cells are nodata = no coverage, never zero biomass. Gridded mean of footprint estimates, model-based (L4A models), not a wall-to-wall measurement; read SE (and the QF/NS layers, not fetched) before use.
